SELECT U.COMPANY_CD , (SELECT COMP_NM FROM T_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD) AS COMP_NM , (SELECT COMP_ENG_NM FROM T_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD) AS COMP_ENG_NM ,U.USER_CD ,U.USER_NM ,U.USER_ENG_NM ,ISNULL(MAX(U.SA_YN),'N') AS SA_YN ,ISNULL(U.DEPT_CD,'') AS DEPT_CD ,ISNULL(D.UP_DEPT_CD,'') AS UP_DEPT_CD ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(D.DEPT_LEVEL,0)) AS DEPT_LEVEL ,U.USER_TITLE ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'USER_TITLE',U.USER_TITLE) AS USER_TITLE_NM ,U.USER_POSIT ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'USER_POSIT',U.USER_POSIT) AS USER_POSIT_NM ,ISNULL(D.DEPT_NM,'') AS DEPT_NM ,D.DEPT_ENG_NM ,AUTH.AUTH_ID ,ISNULL(U.MULTI_LANG,'') AS MULTI_LANG ,U.USER_IMG ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),LAST_LOGIN,120) AS LAST_LOGIN ,U.PASSWD ,U.M_PHONE ,ISNULL(COMPANY_YN,'N') AS COMPANY_YN ,ISNULL(D.SADEPT_YN,'N') AS SADEPT_YN ,ISNULL(U.DSTR_CHN,'') AS DSTR_CHN ,ISNULL(dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE',ISNULL(U.DSTR_CHN,'')),'') AS DSTR_CHN_NM ,ISNULL(AUTH.AUTH_DIV,'N') AS AUTH_DIV ,ISNULL(AUTH.AUTH_TEAM,'N') AS AUTH_TEAM ,ISNULL(AUTH.AUTH_PERS_1,'N') AS AUTH_PERS_1 ,ISNULL(AUTH.AUTH_PERS_2,'N') AS AUTH_PERS_2 ,ISNULL(MAX(U.THEME),'NOTHING') AS THEME FROM T_USER AS U LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON U.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND U.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_AUTH_USER AS AUSR ON U.USER_CD = AUSR.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_AUTHORITY AS AUTH ON AUTH.AUTH_ID = AUSR.AUTH_ID WHERE 1=1
AND U.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND U.PASSWD = #pass_wd#
AND U.USE_YN = #use_yn#
GROUP BY U.COMPANY_CD ,U.USER_CD ,U.USER_NM ,D.DEPT_LEVEL ,U.USER_ENG_NM ,U.DEPT_CD ,D.UP_DEPT_CD ,U.USER_TITLE ,U.USER_POSIT ,D.DEPT_NM ,D.DEPT_ENG_NM ,AUTH.AUTH_ID ,U.MULTI_LANG ,U.USER_IMG ,U.LAST_LOGIN ,U.PASSWD ,U.M_PHONE ,U.MGR_YN ,U.COMPANY_YN ,U.DSTR_CHN ,D.SADEPT_YN ,AUTH.AUTH_DIV ,AUTH.AUTH_TEAM ,AUTH.AUTH_PERS_1 ,AUTH.AUTH_PERS_2
statements.update: UPDATE T_USER SET LAST_LOGIN = GETDATE() WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USER_CD = #user_cd#
UPDATE T_USER SET THEME = #theme# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USER_CD = #user_cd#
